# Business Impact

- **Improved Financial Transparency and ROI Measurement:** By deploying granular Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting, PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC will gain direct visibility into the journey from lead generation to asset under management, enabling management to quantify marketing ROI and optimize spend based on accurate conversion metrics.

- **Operational Efficiency Through Automation:** The automated data ingestion and transformation processes will reduce manual reporting effort for the data, technology, and marketing teams, streamlining workflows and freeing up resources for higher-value activities. This shift is expected to accelerate reporting cycles and enable consistent, refreshable analytics with minimal human intervention.

- **Cost Optimization with Integrated Platforms:** The integration of QuickBooks with existing data sources (Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and Microsoft Fabric) will empower PURE to accurately track CAC, identify inefficiencies in acquisition spend, and reduce cost overruns. Improved data quality and unified reporting will support targeted decision-making that can drive cost savings across marketing and customer acquisition programs.

- **Strategic Value Creation for Leadership:** Enhanced Power BI dashboards and KPI definitions will provide senior leadership with actionable insights to assess pipeline performance and marketing effectiveness at a granular level. This capability will strengthen executive decision-making, support strategic planning initiatives, and enable responsive allocation of resources to growth opportunities.

- **Foundation for Competitive Advantage and Scalable Growth:** The scalable reporting suite and robust data model design position PURE for future expansion, supporting the addition of new data sources and reporting needs without large-scale rework. This flexibility enables PURE to maintain a technological edge, adapting quickly to industry changes while sustaining data-driven business growth.

The proposed solution will enable PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC to significantly increase the maturity of its reporting and analytics—delivering greater clarity, efficiency, and strategic insight at every step of the client journey. By automating key processes and providing leadership with reliable, actionable data, PURE will strengthen its operational foundation, control acquisition costs, and ensure robust support for long-term growth and competitive differentiation.
